item.description:
Toucan 1.0.25

  • After updating, install the Claude extension again: in Settings › Extensions, choose Install… and accept in Claude Desktop, then start a new chat. Updating Toucan doesn’t update the copy Claude Desktop installed, and an older copy can leave files out of what Claude sees.
  • Settings › Extensions now shows the version of the extension Claude Desktop last started. When it’s older than Toucan, the line turns orange, the button reads Install Again… and To Do says so.
  • In Settings › Team › Members, each Mac shows its Toucan and Claude extension versions and when it last reported. Anything out of date is orange; point at it to see what to do. A Mac shows its versions once it has updated to this version.

Toucan 1.0.24

  • More positions are built in for people in Structure: Next generation, Chief executive, Chief investment officer, Chief financial officer, Chief operating officer, Head of family office, Financial controller, General counsel, Executive assistant, Personal assistant and Adviser. Short forms such as CEO, CFO and PA are read as the full title.
  • Every Mac needs to update to this version before anyone gives one of the new positions to someone in a team client.
  • In Settings › Extensions, a new Claude reads row shows the folder Claude Desktop reads: the active client’s Tokenised folder. Claude’s folder is now called the extension’s folder, as it only holds a small hidden file that points Claude to that folder.

Toucan 1.0.23

  • When checking a file or a transcript, Add as now has Alias of…. It opens a list you can search of the names in Replace and the names going to Replace in the same check. Use it for another way of writing a name, such as Mrs Example or a nickname: it gets that name’s token and restores as that name.
  • The Entity Map now has one lane for each category: Assets, Places, Accounts and Other each have their own lane, where Assets used to hold them all. Your firm’s own categories go in Other.
  • Structure’s tables follow the lanes, with the same names and in the same order. Email addresses, phone numbers, IBANs and NI numbers are in a table called Contact details at the end.
